text:
Nina Park: Quick kickoff — proposing a 6-week pilot for a 'remediation steward' to speed PM follow-ups and reduce churn from recurring incidents.
Samir Khan: define steward? role/ownership boundaries?
Nina Park: steward = short-term role that shepherds postmortem actions (not the IC). runs 48h check, mid-week sync, 2-week close push.
Evan Brooks: +1. can we make a compact 4-point timeline for owners: day0 ack, day2 status, day7 unblock/plan, day14 close-or-escalate? keep it tight.
Grace Wu: love day2 instead of day3 — faster feedback loop. also want a lightweight dashboard: owner | action | due | status | repeat-flag.
Samir Khan: repeat-flag? how calculated?
Nina Park: simple: same service/component appears in 2+ incidents in last 60 days -> flag and bump priority to P1-CR (continuous recurrence).
Oncall Rotations Bot: rota notice created: "remediation-steward-rotations" -> signup link posted to #eng-oncall
Evan Brooks: workflow idea: steward checks sheet at 48h, posts a 1-line summary in channel, triggers escalation if blocked >72h.
Grace Wu: put templated Slack pings into a snippet so stewards can copy. e.g.:
```
Hi @<owner>, quick check on PM action #42 — status? blockers? ETA to close?
```
Samir Khan: I'll put together a tiny lambda to compute repeat-flag from incident tags. output = boolean + count. PR by Tue EOD.
Nina Park: owners playbook: 3 bullets max (ack, update, close/escalate). I'll draft and keep under one page.
Evan Brooks: suggest optional 20min weekly 'steward sprint' for all active owners (max 6 slots). optional but helpful for tricky cross-team actions.
Grace Wu: metric set: median time-to-close, % closed by 14d, # recurrence flags. we track weekly.
Oncall Rotations Bot: reminder scheduled -> message to steward at 48h and 7d after thread_ts 3340005678
Samir Khan: question about steward rota: volunteers preferred, fallback to ops lead after 72h if no volunteer.
Nina Park: agreed. escalation path: owner -> steward -> ops lead -> eng manager. document in runbook.
Evan Brooks: pilot boundaries: services infra + platform teams only for 6 weeks. then review with SRE and product.
Grace Wu: can we add a small cheat-sheet for stewards: shortcuts, where to find actions, how to set due dates in tracker. one-pager.
Nina Park: action items: Nina: draft timeline + cheat-sheet; Samir: repeat-flag script; Evan: steward sprint schedule + signup; Grace: dashboard sheet and metrics columns.
Samir Khan: got it. aiming to have initial pieces by next Monday.
Evan Brooks: minor detail: please keep channel pings short — we want low noise. stewards use DMs for owner nudges.
Grace Wu: noted. and we should surface only escalations to the channel.
Nina Park: thanks team. I'll post the pilot doc and signup in #eng-oncall tomorrow AM. any blockers?
Samir Khan: none here. :+1:
Evan Brooks: :thumbsup:
Grace Wu: :wave:
Nina Park: done for now — will follow up with the draft runbook link.
